description: Rounds a number down, to the nearest integer or to the nearest multiple of significance.

params.description: The numeric value to round down.
params.name: arg1

params.description: The multiple of significance to round down to. If it is omitted, the default value of 1 is used.
params.name: arg2

params.description: Specifies if negative numbers are rounded towards or away from zero. If it is omitted or set to 0, negative numbers are rounded away from zero.If any other numeric value is specified, negative numbers are rounded towards zero.
params.name: arg3

signature: FLOOR_MATH(arg1: ApiRange | ApiName | number, arg2?: ApiRange | ApiName | number, arg3?: ApiRange | ApiName | number): number
